command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$taskManifest=Get-Content -LiteralPath 'docs/ai/FILE-OPERATIONS/NTSD-OPTIMIZATION-BATCH36-BRUTE-EXACT-CACHE-20261007/before.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$taskProtectedMismatch=@($taskManifest.protected|Where-Object{!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $_.path) -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $_.sha256})
$taskBackupMismatch=@($taskManifest.before|Where-Object{(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.backup -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne $_.sha256})
$taskValidation=@(& ./Tools/Validate-ChangeLedger.ps1 *>&1|ForEach-Object{$_.ToString()})
$taskValidationExit=$LASTEXITCODE
$taskDiff=@(git diff --check 2>&1|ForEach-Object{$_.ToString()})
$taskDiffExit=$LASTEXITCODE
$taskSource=@($taskManifest.before|Where-Object{$_.path.EndsWith('.cs')}|ForEach-Object{[pscustomobject]@{path=$_.path;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash}})
[pscustomobject]@{observed=(Get-Date).ToString('o');head=(git rev-parse HEAD);headSame=(git rev-parse HEAD) -eq $taskManifest.head;protectedCount=$taskManifest.protected.Count;protectedMismatches=$taskProtectedMismatch;backupCount=$taskManifest.before.Count;backupMismatches=$taskBackupMismatch;validationExit=$taskValidationExit;validationSummary=@($taskValidation|Where-Object{$_ -match '^Change ledger validation|^\s*(Records|Code files|Governed)'});warningCount=@($taskValidation|Where-Object{$_ -match '^\s*WARNING:'}).Count;diffExit=$taskDiffExit;diffIssues=$taskDiff;source=$taskSource;menuSceneSha=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath Assets/NTSD/Scene/NTSD_Menu.unity -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;battleSceneSha=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath Assets/NTSD/Scene/NTSD_Battle.unity -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;sharedRequestAbsent=!(Test-Path -LiteralPath Temp/NTSD_ProductionEntityStress.request.json);sharedTerminalSha=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath Temp/NTSD_ProductionEntityStress.result -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;newWindowsAbsent=!(Test-Path -LiteralPath 'artifacts/diagnostics/NTSD-OPTIMIZATION-BATCH36-BRUTE-EXACT-CACHE-20261007/windows-01');editorPid=(Get-Process -Id 19040).Id} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
